verdict.rationale: Fin's pricing page lists analytics features like 'AI Topics, Trends... Monitors... Incident Detection' and 'Insights continuously analyzes every Fin and human conversation,' indicating topic clustering and emerging-issue detection capability, but there is no deeper documentation, screenshots, or independent corroboration of how this works in practice. Missing for 10: detailed product docs on topic clustering methodology, evidence of proactive alerting before ticket-volume spikes, and independent/hands-on validation of the insights/analytics feature.
